text:
alex: heads up — noticed a spike in requests attributed to 'project: -' today during the rollout. dashboard shows org-level key usage but no project, so quota and billing are wrong

maria: ugh, we saw that too on dev, looked like the token exchange path dropped the project claim then fell back to org. any traces? :thinking_face:

alex: logs show authn service responded with a 200 and claim set to empty. example log line:
  authz: allow key=org:acme user=sa-cluster project=
  route: default -> dedicated-gpu-1

sam: is this specific to exchanged keys or also raw API keys?

alex: mostly for exchanged service tokens that come from 3rd party connectors. raw API keys still have project populated. connector path strips project when origin header missing.

izzy: we should add a telemetry metric for "fallback_to_org" with a tag for origin_claim_source. right now we only emit quota attribution counts which hides the fallback rate.

maria: +1. also we need a console surface for when a project is missing so support can see "why" requests landed under org. small table on the key detail page listing recent fallbacks

sam: quick strawman for API change: authn returns a X-Auth-Provenance header on token introspect that includes claim_origin and real_project if different. e.g.,
  X-Auth-Provenance: claim_origin=exchange_connector;resolved_project=none

alex: I like the header, but want to avoid changing too many call sites. alternative: emit an audit event on fallback with trace_id and sample the full claim chain. observability can wire that into traces.

izzy: we can do both. header for immediate routing logic, audit event for console and tracing. header is opt-in and only present for tokens that had non-default flow.

maria: UX question — where in console should this show? key detail? request logs? billing page?

sam: key detail + request logs. billing page should surface a link to the list of fallback samples if rate > 1% so finance can query.

alex: implementation notes:
  - authn: add claim_origin enum and include in introspect + audit event
  - router: check claim_origin == 'none' and increment metric fallback_to_org{connector,exchange,missing_header}
  - console: new telemetry widgets and a small list on key detail

izzy: suggest metric names: rwi_auth_fallback_total (labels: org, key_id, origin), rwi_auth_fallback_sampled_traces (labels: org, key_id)

maria: can we make the console show a link that triggers a sampled trace lookup? would be super helpful in support flow.

alex: yeah, console can call /internal/trace-samples?org=acme&key=... which returns N examples with minimal pii. kept to sampled traces.

observability-bot: note created: Fallback telemetry epic created under OBS-2417, sampling set to 0.1% initially.

sam: rollout plan? want to avoid noisy metrics at launch.

izzy: start with a 0.1% sample rate for full traces, emit the fallback counter at full fidelity. header opt-in behind flag 'auth_provenance_header' per-env.

maria: can we also gate console widgets behind flag so we can toggle on for support first?

alex: yep feature flagging planned. i'll open a PR with the authn + router changes and a design ticket for the console bits.

sam: thumbs up. can we also add a small internal alert if fallback rate > 0.5% sustained for 15m? that would catch regressions fast.

izzy: yep add an alert rwi_auth_fallback_rate > 0.005 for 15m with runbook link to trace samples and key detail.

maria: thanks — once PR is in, drop a note here and i'll schedule a quick UX review for the key detail mockup. :+1:

alex: will do. PR link incoming when ready.
